title: 需求澄清与模型细化
scope: 保留显式有限解释上的行为澄清；新增原文请求、未确认领域候选合同、引用/结构检查和提示准备，无语言传输或自动抽取。
implemented_scope: Explicit finite interpretation lists with raw-byte-pinned sources, injected preview/observation, minimax boolean questions, immutable answer history and successor-task-bound proposals; standard library and protocols only; no exhaustive interpretation search, automatic gap classification, semantic fidelity proof, model writes or LLM judge; raw UTF-8 source requests and unconfirmed domain definition candidates with attributed concepts/attributes/relations/rules/issues, strict structural inspection and prompt preparation, no language transport/extraction or rule execution Adds source/request-bound typed-domain-candidate/0.1 inspection and finite-language prompt preparation; no live language transport, answer-driven revision, or independent semantic acceptance. Instance rule execution belongs to the explicit apps adapter, not this package.
